Portrait clinical algorithm: risk and compatible symptoms lead to red-flag screening; red flags route to emergency care and parenteral thiamine; otherwise draw whole-blood thiamine diphosphate and lactate, start thiamine without waiting, evaluate other causes in parallel, and reassess symptoms, lactate and neurologic status
